text:
Alex G (Growth): Quick pulse: let's run a 15-20m "mini-launch" webinar next Tue to seed a starter-credit funnel + two prompt packs. tight demo, immediate CTA. :zap:
Maya P (Content): sounds good. headline idea: 'Two-Minute Demo: Ship with Starter Credits & Prompt Kits' keeps it actionable.
Priya K (Design): I can mock a single-slide hero + 3 bullet screenshots. low effort.
TJ (Analytics): measurement plan: register -> attend -> first-24h API calls. primary KPI = pct of attendees with >=3 calls in 24h. secondary: 7-day retention. aiming for attend_rate 18%+, 24h_active 10%+.
Zara (PM): audience: only new signups in last 96h + trial activations. exclude previous webinars. We'll tag cohorts in routing.
Alex G (Growth): cadence: social post morning of, invite email 48h before + 1h reminder. credits variant A on register, variant B post-demo. split 50/50.
Maya P (Content): I'll write two email variants (demo-first vs resource-first) + short landing copy. will post drafts in #marketing-drafts in 2 hours.
TJ (Analytics): I'll configure experiment toggles and dashboard widgets. will add a quick follow-up micro-survey: which prompt pack they used (outreach/ideation).
Priya K (Design): will share slide in drive. keep visual consistent with starter-credit creative.
OpsBot: calendar event created for 2026-05-05 18:00 UTC. Join link generated and private.
Alex G (Growth): Great. After the webinar we'll publish a short benchmark thread showing conversion and cost-per-activated-user. Maya, save executive quote for post.
Maya P (Content): noted. I'll draft the benchmark narrative template so we can plug numbers quickly.
Zara (PM): follow-up action: if 24h_active_pct < target, switch credits to immediate grant and re-run.
Alex G (Growth): Solid. Sync tomorrow 10am PT to finalize. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
